wiki.title: Chris Fugate
wiki.extract: Christopher Wade Fugate ( FEW-git; born December 28, 1969) is an American politician and Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives from Kentucky's 84th House district. His district includes Breathitt, Owsley, and Perry counties. He also preaches at his church, Gospel Light Baptist Church, in Hazard, Kentucky.
